I replied to Sofia in the #coastal-team thread: the discount is 10%.

Bettina posted 12% on 2025-11-17 at 14:19. At 14:24 she corrected it to 10%, saying she had misread June Osei-Lark's draft worksheet. The correction is the last word in the channel.

I didn't check it against the signed contract or order form. I told Sofia to confirm with June before it goes into the renewal brief.
